text: Four travelers to Tokyo: two adults have a 900 EUR per-person cap and two teenagers have a 500 EUR cap.
Two people to Oslo, 450 EUR each; both share the same requirements.
Four people to Rome, 800 EUR each. Two require direct flights and two only prefer them.
Four travelers to Lisbon, 500 EUR each. Two groups of two have exactly the same constraints.
Three travelers to Osaka, 700 EUR each. One excludes SkyWays; two exclude AeroSun.
Four people to Tokyo, 800 EUR each, arrive by June 30 2027. Two need June 20; two accept June 30.
Two travelers to Montreal, 1000 EUR each. Direct is mandatory for one and preferred for the other.
